label: DERIVED from the viewer's drawn pose (registered GPS + viewer interpolation/smoothing); not the true car position

timeBases.t: recorded lap t = GPS base = viewer playback clock = kerb_contacts.json / apex_kpi.json apexT base
timeBases.lapTime: t + deltaSeconds (meta.first_sample_after_lap_start_seconds) = true lap time = HUD lap clock (video overlay timer base; overlay lap = data lap + 1, see artifacts/video-position-gap-2026-10-02)

pose.source: dump_viewer_pose.ts: origin/master src/replay/interpolation.ts sampleReplay + src/engine/poseSmoothing.ts PoseSmoother(DEFAULT: 2 x 70 ms, look-ahead 0.14 s, linear input) run under vite-node; continuous 1x playback from the lap start (snap at t=0) stepped at 100 Hz
pose.position: registered GPS (gps_registration.json, lap/limits/track SHA-256 verified -> enabled; antenna offset 0 = vehicle centre) through the viewer C1 Hermite; no positional smoothing in the viewer
pose.yaw: drawn = smoothed pose quaternion yaw; target = sampleReplay heading (+-6-sample = +-0.6 s chord of registered points, linearly interpolated between 10 Hz samples)
pose.tyres: outer edges, centre +- wheelbase/2 along the DRAWN yaw, +-(track+tyre width)/2 across (mazda2-dj.json); same convention as build_apex_kpi.py

definitions.gap: m, inner tyre outer edge to kerb line; NEGATIVE = on the kerb; paint = road-side start of the white strip (track-limit line), block = road-side start of the red/white blocks (cg_study/kerb_zones.json); NaN beyond the line end vertices (apex_kpi line_gap)
definitions.pass: samples whose nearest-vertex CG station lies within the kerb station range +-3 m (apex_kpi pass window)
definitions.apex: CG clipping point = argmin gBlockFront over the pass (apex_kpi definition); apexNearestTyre = argmin of min(front, rear)
definitions.block/paint .nearestTyre/.front/.rear: CG first contact tFirst = first sub-sample crossing to gap <= 0 inside the pass, last contact tLast = crossing back above 0 after the last on-kerb sample; onSeconds = time with gap <= 0; contactRuns = separate on-kerb intervals; null = no contact in the CG
definitions.turnIn: heading-rate onset of the corner as drawn = cgpose.rate_onset (same function usable on logger series) on the yaw rate towards the kerb side (left kerb = left turn), referenced to the CG apex: {"smooth_s": 0.3, "peak_window": [-4.0, 4.0], "near_peak": 0.9, "back_limit_s": 8.0, "hyst_min": 0.3, "hyst_frac": 0.02, "plateau_frac": 0.15, "plateau_s": 0.25, "slope_ref_s": 3.0, "fractions": [0.1, 0.25, 0.5], "weak": 8.0}; see the rate_onset docstring. Keys: tPeak/ratePeakDegS, tFoot/rateFootDegS (foot of the rising flank; footStop = flat | rate-rises-again | search-limit), rateBaseDegS = max(foot rate, 0), t10/t25/t50 = crossings of base + NN % of (peak - base), tLinear0 = 2*t25 - t50; every t has lapTime*/stationSmooth* twins. weakCorner = peak - base < 8 deg/s. quality = good when not weak, peak not on the window edge, footStop != search-limit, foot->tNearPeak <= 5.0 s and t50 defined, else check (use t50 first; t10/tLinear0 are the most sensitive). drawnYaw = drawn car body (primary); targetYaw = unsmoothed chord heading; course = direction of motion of the drawn position (Hermite derivative; smooth_s 0.5 s)
definitions.station: continuous projection on the CG road centreline polyline (geometry.json); stationNV = nearest centreline vertex (0.5 m, apex_kpi apexStation); lateral = signed offset of the car reference point, + = driver right. stationSmooth/lateralSmooth = projection on a periodic cubic spline through the 652 track.json vertices (parametrised by CG station, equal at the vertices): continuous, use it for along-track differences. The polyline has 4-31 deg kinks every ~7 m in corners, so `station` jumps by up to ~4.4 m inside corners (measured)
definitions.pathDistM: cumulative distance of the drawn reference point since t = 0 (traces only)

caveats: The chord heading (+-0.6 s) blurs the yaw-rate onset in time (drawn/target onsets lead the course onset); compare each logger/video onset with the same definition.
Kerb lines come from the 2019 orthophoto; GPS lateral error after registration ~+-0.5-0.7 m (docs/fuji-position-gap-status-2026-10-09.html).
Lap start/end: the viewer clamps and the chord heading is one-sided within 0.6 s of the lap ends.
Along-track differences: use stationSmooth, pathDistM or time; the polyline station (and apex_kpi apexStation) jumps by up to ~4 m at the 7 m centreline kinks when the car is metres inside a corner.

Turn-in in Fuji sector 3 / 300R: several kerbs sit in same-direction sequences (k18->k19, k20->k21, k9->k10, k23->k24); their onset is measured from the valley between the corners, k15 (100R) and k23 are long/weak.
